title: Count Signal Deliveries
prompt: POSIX. A handler (given) increments a `volatile sig_atomic_t` counter for SIGUSR1. Implement `int install_usr1_handler(void)` — install it with sigaction, return 0 on success and -1 on failure — and `int usr1_count(void)` returning the counter. Handler-touches-flags-only is the whole discipline.

tests.name: install succeeds
tests.hint: sigaction with a handler for SIGUSR1 returns 0.

tests.name: delivery counted
tests.hint: raise sends the signal to the calling process; the handler bumps the sig_atomic_t flag.

tests.name: three deliveries
tests.hint: Each raise is one synchronous delivery; the counter sees all three.
